card.description: The Obelisk of the Scribe rises 12 meters from a basalt foundation, its tapering shaft etched with luminous hieroglyphic glyphs that pulse in sync with a crystalline core embedded within. A ring of floating sigils encircles the base, shifting as data streams flow through obsidian conduits that channel energy into the obelisk’s apex. This ancient-tech command node blends Ethiopian and Egyptian aesthetics with incomprehensible, industrial mysticism, rendered in photorealistic, tactile detail.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** 12‑meter basalt obelisk, tapering to a pointed apex, base circumference 4 m, embedded with obsidian conduits forming a lattice of energy channels.
**Face/Sensors:** Central glyph panel at the apex functions as a sensor array, projecting holographic glyphs; micro‑emitters along the shaft provide ambient illumination.
**Key Features:** Luminous hieroglyphic glyphs, crystalline core, obsidian conduits, floating sigil ring, energy‑channeling lattice.
evolution: Phase 1 (Dormant): Obelisk stands inert, glyphs faintly glowing, sigils static.
Phase 2 (Activated): Glyphs blaze, core hums, sigils swirl, energy flows through conduits.
props: Item: Ancient Tablet of Records – a weathered basalt tablet with etched script, placed at the obelisk’s base.
Item: Crystalline Core – a 30 cm spherical crystal, pulsing with internal light, housed within the obelisk’s apex.
